responsibility: Implements shared behavior for deferred analyzer diagnostics and notes. It provides common equality helpers for tree-based deduplication, macro-aware location fixups, default construction of function-entry/call/region-creation/final warning events in checker paths, and formatting support for event descriptions, forming the reusable base logic that concrete pending_diagnostic subclasses customize for specific warnings.
same_name_distinction: Implements shared pending_diagnostic behavior declared in pending-diagnostic.h, including tree comparison helpers, macro-location fixups, generic path-event construction, interesting-region utilities, and formatted event-description support.
